source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Understood—the available routing space is important as well, rather than only the component placement. I also want to retain the ESP32 through-hole breakout, since I intend to reuse this main board as a general ESP32-S3 base platform in other projects involving a display, MCU, and buttons. Having access to every pin is a hard requirement for me.
Do you have any suggestions, such as changing these to 1.25 rather than 2.54?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Overall, everything on the boards looks good: every connector, component, and circuit matches the spec. I only have a few questions about the BOM: (1) why do the shunt resistors R20 and R21 use different packages (2512 vs 1206), and can they be standardized? (2) J1/J2/J3 on the ESP32 breakout provide 40 pins (1×14 + 1×12 + 1×14), while the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 has 44 pins. Are the 4 absent pins the power/ground pins (3V3, GND) that are already connected to the rails, or are any GPIOs missing? (3) BOM\_POW.xlsx in the sensor board folder is actually the power board BOM, so please create the correct sensor board BOM. Also, ignore the message above because it was autogenerated by upwork from the Great . as link :)
